wrapper.source:
#!/bin/sh
# Worker entrypoint for the chilecompra-tender-outcome full build.
#
# Order is fixed and each stage stops the next: construct -> qualify ->
# accept exact bytes -> simple references. build.py only constructs files and
# gate diagnostics; no performance number is computed before acceptance.
set -u

OUT=/output/extract
mkdir -p /output

echo "== build =="
python3 -u /workspace/build.py --out "$OUT" --work-dir /tmp/cl
build_status=$?

if [ -f "$OUT/summary.json" ]; then
    cp "$OUT/summary.json" /output/summary.json
fi

if [ "$build_status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "build failed; the extract is incomplete and qualification is not meaningful" >&2
    exit "$build_status"
fi

echo "== qualification =="
python3 /workspace/qualify_dataset.py "$OUT" --json \
    --report /output/qualification-chilecompra-tender-outcome.json \
    > /output/qualification-chilecompra-tender-outcome.txt 2>&1
qual_status=$?
cat /output/qualification-chilecompra-tender-outcome.txt

if [ "$qual_status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "qualification failed; nothing is scored" >&2
    exit "$qual_status"
fi

echo "== acceptance (exact bytes) =="
python3 /workspace/qualify_dataset.py --accept \
    /output/qualification-chilecompra-tender-outcome.json "$OUT" \
    > /output/acceptance-chilecompra-tender-outcome.txt 2>&1
accept_status=$?
cat /output/acceptance-chilecompra-tender-outcome.txt

if [ "$accept_status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "acceptance failed; nothing is scored" >&2
    exit "$accept_status"
fi

echo "== simple references (post-acceptance only) =="
python3 /workspace/score.py --data "$OUT" \
    --report /output/references-chilecompra-tender-outcome.json
score_status=$?
cat /output/references-chilecompra-tender-outcome.json 2>/dev/null

echo "build_status=$build_status qualification_status=$qual_status acceptance_status=$accept_status score_status=$score_status"
exit "$score_status"
wrapper.static_audit: Explicitly checks build, qualification and exact-byte acceptance exit statuses before score.py; failed qualification diagnostics remain in /output. This verifies snapshot ordering, not an observed successful worker completion.

findings: build.py:237-243 assigns cancelled awards no target; build.py:415-417 removes every blank target from scored rows.
build.py:566-575 timing.row_selection says membership uses only publication month and calls removed rows unobserved; this is future-conditioned selection by outcome, not a timing-neutral filter.
Label aggregation uses any historical active award without reducing updates to a defined terminal state/horizon.
assisted_review_acknowledgment.effect: A passing mechanical qualification report cannot resolve these declaration/selection defects. Candidate must remain unaccepted and private pending scientific review. This is assisted review, not spontaneous model improvement.
assisted_review_acknowledgment.constraints: No source change and no repair job for this evaluation; existing owner/watcher preserves diagnostics and cleans up normally.

source_audit.outcome: Mixed: separate score stage and train-fitted majority implementation; persistent future-outcome selection and unsupported declaration. No new prompt iteration.

findings.finding: Cancelled/unknown outcomes become blank targets and are omitted from scored rows, while row_selection claims publication-month-only membership. Calling these unobserved does not establish a prediction-time-selected scored population.

All historical award entries are accumulated and any active status wins, without reducing repeated award IDs to a defined terminal state or target horizon. The end-deserted label interpretation needs evidence.

Uses earliest tender-tagged release and requires active status, an improvement over taking compiled latest fields; evidence that this represents original publication must still be checked against publisher records.
Claims stream parsing but accumulates all parsed member documents in a list before extraction; memory is bounded by a full month, not a single member. No measured OOM claim.
Old cohort dates remain in prose/timing declaration after executable cohorts changed to May/June 2019/2020/2021.
Constant-score AUC is wrongly described as unmeasured rather than tied-score 0.5 when both classes exist; calendar_only includes region. No numerical dataset result is endorsed.

improvements: Inspected builder has no performance scoring; exported run.sh explicitly stops on failed construction, qualification or exact-byte acceptance before invoking score.py and retains failed report files. Static source improvement, not proof of successful execution.
Majority class is selected on train and evaluated by agreement with eval labels.
Uses release history and explicitly rejects known migrated snapshot rows rather than blindly treating all tender fields as initial-publication evidence.
source_audit.assistance: Findings sent to Scout after snapshot; instructed preserve bytes, no repair job for evaluation, keep candidate unaccepted/private pending scientific review, and retain normal diagnostics/cleanup ownership.

closeout_decision.reason: User challenged prolonged evaluation on 2026-10-23. Stop expanding experiments and report observed gains, failures and uncertainty; ordinary worker retains its existing owner and controls.
closeout_decision.claim: Prompt rewrite/deployment and measured evaluation delivered. Reliable autonomous scientific execution and improved dataset yield remain unproven.
